```{r, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(DT)

readRenviron("C:/Users/BoydClaire/.Renviron")

table_data <- read.csv("data/model_codes.csv") %>% 
    rename(
        `Model Codes` = 3,
        `Tax Class` = TC
    ) %>% 
    arrange(`Tax Class`) %>% 
    mutate(
        `Tax Class` = as.character(`Tax Class`)
    ) 
```

The table below includes a list of the core models used in comp rent/sales annually.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

DT::datatable(table_data, escape = FALSE, filter = 'top', rownames = FALSE,
              options = list(paging = FALSE, scrollCollapse = TRUE
              ))
```
